usedFor: monday.com tracks work on boards and Teamwork runs projects, so “Item Column Value Changes” can feed “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Create Project” in Teamwork
bestTemplate.why: A column change on a board can open the matching project in Teamwork.

watchOut: “Item Column Value Changes” fires on every column edit, so “Create Project” can run more than once for an item.
